purpose: Teach: 整体/愛人/クリエイティブ/ディーゼル/ゴジラ/任天堂/ラウンジ/スプリング

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、肩こりで整体行ってたな
lines.en: Riku, you went to a chiropractor for your shoulder pain, didn't you?
lines.style: Casual tease, eyebrow raised. Light and knowing. No malice—just catching him in something small and comfortable to call out. Quick pace.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ドラマの愛人ものハマってたな、桜
lines.en: You got obsessed with that drama about mistresses, Sakura.
lines.style: Soft wry smile. Turning it back on her without heat. A little amused at his own deflection. Comfortable rhythm, like this volley is familiar.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、デザインがクリエイティブだな
lines.en: Riku, your design work is actually really creative.
lines.style: Genuine praise breaking through the teasing. Slightly vulnerable—she means it and knows it matters to him. Softer attack, earnest eye contact.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ディーゼル車の音マネしてたな、桜
lines.en: You were doing diesel engine sounds in the hallway last week, Sakura.
lines.style: Dry return serve. Slight smirk in the voice. Not defensive—just matching her sincerity with his own deflecting humor. Measured, light.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ゴジラの最新作観たろ?
lines.en: Riku, you saw the new Godzilla movie, right?
lines.style: Quick shift to genuine curiosity. Wants his take, not to catch him. Voice opens up. Still teasing undertone but the question is real.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、任天堂のゲーム実況してたろ?桜
lines.en: You streamed Nintendo games the other day, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Mirroring her curiosity back at her. A small smile underneath. Testing whether she's ready to drop the teasing game. Gentle, observant tone.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ホテルラウンジ憧れてるな
lines.en: Riku, you've been looking at hotel lounges online, haven't you?
lines.style: Amused, slightly incredulous. The kind of observation that lands because it's oddly specific and true. Gentle mockery—not mean. Lighter rhythm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、スプリングセールで服買ってたな、桜
lines.en: You bought new clothes at the spring sale, didn't you, Sakura?
lines.style: Closer in. Quieter. Less teasing now—more noticing. A small moment of real attention. Like he's seeing her, not just trading volleys. Softer, intimate pace.
